correctness.rationale: For an odd polygon the longest directed vertex differences have 2n equally spaced directions and length 2R cos(a). Other chords (when present) have length at most 2R cos(3a), less than the least projection 2R cos²(a) from the nearest longest direction. For even n the centrally symmetric polygon immediately gives the stated profile. Uniform folding then gives the pair pushforward. Product-to-sum integration on [-a,a−t] and [a−t,a] gives the exact covariance; its derivative is strictly negative by monotonicity of sinc, and the two endpoints have opposite signs by nonconstancy and strict countermonotonicity. The shift π/2 is congruent to 0 or a according to the stated residue. The area inversions use uniform X and, in the opposite branch, uniform |2X−a|; they concern fixed-orientation enclosing rectangles only. Uniform cosine expansion and the two-piece second-moment integral give K_a(au)/K_a(0) = 1−(15/8)u²(2−u)²+O(a²) uniformly; its unique root is 1−sqrt(1−sqrt(8/15)) and its endpoint is −7/8. The supplied verifier under verification/verify.py and its recorded finite diagnostics were inspected, not rerun. The all-n claims rest on the proof.
